propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard calls git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, causing ~207 runner-seconds overhead (~75s projected wall-time savings) on the 13k-test suite.
Current per-test HEAD-move detection via two Git subprocesses per test can be replaced with in-process HEAD fingerprinting after one-time per-worker Git metadata discovery.
The proposed optimization must preserve exact per-test contract: detect checkout HEAD moves, name responsible test, retain allow_repo_writes escape, and preserve session dirty-tree backstop.

Four surveyed OSS projects (pytest, pip, poetry, pre-commit) reach 4/4 consensus that source-checkout VCS subprocesses should not run in the per-test hot path, but no consensus implementation primitive exists for rebar's stricter per-test checkout-HEAD attribution.
No hand-parsed ref implementation or added Git library dependency (Dulwich/pygit2/GitPython) meets the automatic-approval consensus bar for this change.
